name: frontend-long-observe
purpose: Same path as title_to_frontend, but presses A with hold-until-confirmed and then watches the front-end load for five more minutes. Answers the question both 186 s runs were cut off before: does the post-START load ever finish, and what does the game do next?

steps.name: settle-title
steps.purpose: Title era composed; guarded on FE ticks, not a wall clock.

steps.name: press-start
steps.purpose: PRESS START until the guest itself loads the front-end movie.

steps.name: first-screen
steps.purpose: FE flow FSM latched its first screen id.

steps.name: clear-dialog
steps.purpose: Accept the storage dialog with A. Held until the guest is observed sampling it, because the front end polls XamInputGetState at ~1 Hz during this load and a short press is a coin flip (iter-450V: 1 of 5 short presses landed, twice running).

steps.name: observe-long
steps.purpose: THE MEASUREMENT. Five minutes of unattended observation. The resource-request ordinal keeps counting even with the per-request log arm gated, so load progress is readable from the log afterwards whether or not it completes.
